copy.tagline_en: Follow Python coding standards and best practices
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your Python code to follow PEP 8 and Google style

howto.what: Claude 会按照 Google Python 风格指南（兼容 PEP 8）编写 Python 代码，强制使用类型注解，推荐列表/字典推导式、生成器，使用 asyncio 处理并发，并明确处理异常。
howto.when: 当你要求编写或审查 Python 代码时，Claude 会自动应用这些标准。

say.text: 帮我写一个读取 CSV 文件的 Python 函数，加上类型注解。
say.note: Claude 会生成带类型注解的代码。

say.text: 审查这段 Python 代码是否符合 Google 风格。
say.note: Claude 会检查并给出改进建议。

howto.what_en: Claude will write Python code following Google Python Style Guide (PEP 8 compliant), enforce type hints, prefer comprehensions and generators, use asyncio for concurrency, and handle exceptions explicitly.
howto.when_en: When you ask to write or review Python code, Claude automatically applies these standards.

say_en.text: Write a Python function to read a CSV file with type hints.
say_en.note: Claude generates code with type annotations.

say_en.text: Review this Python code for Google style compliance.
